name: Furnace Layer
description: Layer of New Phyrexia controlled by Urabrask, sealed off from other Phyrexian factions.

timeline.summary: Ghalma the Shaper turned a razor circle into a tunnel to the Furnace Layer refugee outposts.
timeline.quote: has turned a "razor circle"—a kind of crop circle carved magically in razorgrass—into a tunnel through Mirrodin's crust into the Furnace Layer.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Machine Orthodoxy
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Machine Orthodoxy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vy Covalt is caught and dissected by Threx after leading Mirrans to safety.
timeline.quote: before being caught and dissected by Threx himself.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Urabrask decrees 'Let them be' regarding the Mirran refugees, ending the killings.
timeline.quote: his three-word decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Urabrask forbids other Phyrexian factions from entering the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: No others are to enter the Furnace Layer, lest the metal be made impure

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mirrans settle among the furnaces, learning to keep camps small and unobtrusive.
timeline.quote: Slowly at first, the Mirrans set up camp amid the furnaces and Phyrexians.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Quiet Furnace". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Urabrask orders his furnace legions to ignore Mirran refugees in the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Urabrask has commanded his furnace legions to turn a blind eye to the refugees.

citation.work: Getting to Know the Praetors
citation.text: "Getting to Know the Praetors". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After Phyrexia conquers Mirrodin, Urabrask lets Mirran survivors take refuge in the Furnace Layer and seals it from other factions.
timeline.quote: Urabrask allowed the Mirran survivors to take refuge in the Furnace Layer of the plane

citation.work: Urabrask
citation.text: "Urabrask", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Urabrask's domain; the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters and Urabrask's red Phyrexians dwell in the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Inevitably, Elesh Norn laid waste to his domain

citation.work: Urabrask
citation.text: "Urabrask", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Kaya emerge from the lacuna into the Furnace Layer and spot the Mirran camp.
timeline.quote: True to its name, the Furnace Layer burned .

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead.
timeline.quote: Koth, I thought you were dead!

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya reunites with Tyvar and Jace, who explains the barrier broke the mindlink and the strike force is scattered.
timeline.quote: The barrier broke that link, along with so many other things.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace says Nissa was shunted away by a trap, as if forced to planeswalk again.
timeline.quote: a trap shunted her away

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya returns Kaito's sword to him and the tanuki drone leaps back to his shoulder.
timeline.quote: untying the blade and slapping the hilt into Kaito's palm

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace states that the plan stays the same: get the sylex to the base of the World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: If we don't get the sylex to the base of their World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities, all the planes will share Mirrodin's fate.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira reveals Elesh Norn calls the tree her Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn calls it her Realmbreaker.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, hearing Karn and Ajani are missing, notes that both know too much about the sylex.
timeline.quote: Ajani destroyed the last one.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira demands honesty about what the sylex will do to Mirrodin, arguing her people have already survived the end of their plane.
timeline.quote: Your plane doesn't matter so much more than ours that I'm going to help you sacrifice what little we have left.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Using Nahiri's stone shaping, Melira builds a model of Mirrodin's nested layers, showing the Seedcore at its center.
timeline.quote: This is the Seedcore,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira explains the Mycosynth Gardens fungus and how Phyrexia took Mirrodin, and the Fair Basilica as Elesh Norn's stronghold.
timeline.quote: They seeded the center of our plane with fungus that pumped Phyrexian contamination into the air

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth explains the route down through the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay to land in the Dross Pits above the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth describes the Mirrans' dire survival and resolve; Elspeth apologizes for leaving.
timeline.quote: As long as one of us is breathing, we'll keep fighting back.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he is not sure the plane will survive the sylex but says there is no time for a new plan.
timeline.quote: No. No, I'm not.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace confesses the plan is to set off a bomb in the center of the plane, and Melira agrees to help provided they do not lie about the risk.
timeline.quote: We're setting off a bomb in the center of the plane.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth introduces hexgold, a Mirran metal that protects somewhat against phyresis, and offers it for the team's gear.
timeline.quote: Our gear has been treated with a substance we call hexgold.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
timeline.quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tyvar prepare their weapons with hexgold.
timeline.quote: breaking his sword into its individual throwing stars

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth announces he will join the descent with a demolition team as a backup if the sylex fails.
timeline.quote: I have a demolition team standing by to do what needs to be done if your sylex fails.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri removes her bandage and reveals the Phyrexian spike growing from her neck; Melira, who suspected, confronts her.
timeline.quote: revealing the blunt, hardened spike growing there

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri cuts the spike open and tries hexgold powder, which fails to cure her.
timeline.quote: It didn't work,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira offers to heal Nahiri but warns it would sideline her for days; Nahiri chooses to fight on, with Melira to heal her later.
timeline.quote: So we fight now, and I heal you later.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Urabrask retreats to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands while the other praetors prepare for invasion.
timeline.quote: While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.

citation.work: Urabrask the Hidden
citation.text: Urabrask the Hidden (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: When the Mirran resistance arrives, Urabrask decrees 'Let them be.'
timeline.quote: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance.

citation.work: Urabrask the Hidden
citation.text: Urabrask the Hidden (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: This is the largest of the camps, situated near the Great Furnace.
